name: read_file
description: Read one UTF-8 file relative to the confined workspace root.

path.description: Relative file path inside the workspace root

name: write_file
description: Write UTF-8 text to a relative path inside the configured workspace root. Parent directories must already exist.

path.description: Relative file path inside the workspace root

name: memory_search
description: Search archived runtime evidence when exact older tool results, arguments, failures, or decisions may be relevant. Returns relative paths for memory_read without injecting the archive into the prompt.

query.description: Tool name, path, error fragment, identifier, or other evidence text

name: memory_read
description: Recover the exact archived runtime events referenced by a short-memory pointer. Use only when the pointer's compact metadata is insufficient for the current task.

path.description: Exact relative path copied from a recoverable short-memory pointer

name: runtime_complete
description: End the active run successfully after all task requirements and validation are complete. Call this alone, with no other tool calls in the same response.

summary.description: Concise final status describing the completed work and validation
